title: Pure Madolche
summary: Madolche cards only, with generic staples. Madolche monsters shuffle themselves back into the Deck when the opponent destroys them, and Madolche Chateau sends those returns to your hand instead. Madolche Salon grants an extra Madolche Normal Summon and sets a Madolche Spell/Trap from the Deck each time a Madolche card goes back. Madolche Petingcessoeur summons itself with an empty GY and brings out another Madolche from the Deck at one Level lower, which lines up Rank 4 and Rank 5 Xyz. The 2024 cards lead. Madolche Mini Meowcaroons searches any Madolche card, Madolche Queen Tiarafraise stacks on Tiaramisu and shuffles away the opponent's cards on their turn, and Madolche Dessert bounces two monsters to summon a bigger Madolche.
